name: Seattle Metals, Inc & Waterjet
old_description: Seeking to deliver on our promise to be our customer’s partner, we focus our efforts not just on a project’s success, but on our customer’s success. With that aim, we develop plans that optimize our in-house capabilities and long term partnerships, while providing a one stop solution for your project needs.
about:
Seattle Metals, Inc & Waterjet operates from Everett, Washington, and was founded in 2013 when two young entrepreneurs pooled resources to purchase equipment that allowed them to custom-bend sheet metal on the same day it was needed. The business has since grown into a focused, tight-knit team that emphasizes long-term development alongside its customers.

The company specializes in custom sheet metal fabrication, offering services such as bending, coping, siding, roofing, and door pans. Its name also references waterjet cutting capability, and it positions itself as a one-stop solution by combining in-house processes with long-term vendor partnerships. The shop targets quick turnaround, advertising same-day bending and unparalleled lead times at competitive pricing.

Primary customers come from the construction and architectural metalwork sectors, where products like coping, siding, roofing components, and door pans are used. The firm’s partnership model is built around repeat projects, seeking clients who value a collaborative, ongoing relationship rather than one-off transactions.

The founders frame the business around a purpose of supplying superior metal manufacturing solutions to “bless people’s lives.” Stated values include humility, excellence, and integrity, with a promise to act as a trustworthy partner who succeeds only when the customer succeeds.
